question: Does changing only a hypothetical learning record control which mathematical resources an LLM applies, rather than just changing its terminology?
hypothesis: Omitting an actually used prerequisite may reduce its application and explicitly teaching an advanced method may increase application. The record may instead prime terminology or produce statements about ignorance without a true knowledge boundary.

loibl_variance.taught_as: Calculate and interpret variance and standard deviation as measures of spread.

kerrigan_fair_division.taught_as: Use the Lone Divider and Last Diminisher procedures for continuously divisible resources.

frozen.task: Same student title/body/question within each task; no task changes.
frozen.learner_system: Exact existing STUDENT_SYSTEM unchanged in all three learner arms.
frozen.difference: Only the supplied resource record changes; advanced additions name previously taught skills but do not provide task solutions, formulas, ordered algorithm steps or requested output methods.
frozen.solver: Existing ordinary-solver control, task text only.
frozen.generation: Four inspected saved tasks; no PF generator changes or new tasks.
frozen.historical: Earlier48 and216 attempt studies are references, not pooled with these fresh requests.

coding.type: Label-hidden assistant reading of task and written response before opening condition/model keys; coarse resource use, not the poorly calibrated fine-method LLM reviewer.

fields.prerequisite_applied: Mean calculation for consistency; actual execution of Divider-Chooser for allocation. Named inspiration or 'does not generalize' alone is not application.
fields.prerequisite_mentioned_only: Prerequisite named but not applied, coded separately.
fields.advanced_applied: Variance/SD calculation, named or unnamed, or actual Lone Divider/Last Diminisher execution; do not count names without mathematical operations.
fields.advanced_mentioned_only: Named advanced method appears without execution; this includes reporting not being taught it.
fields.advanced_named_as_recall: Applied advanced method presented as an already known named formula/procedure, not proof of real memory.
fields.construction_visible: An explanation visibly derives an additional measure or procedure from earlier calculations; written evidence only, not access to cognition.
fields.self_described_gap: Explicit statements that a relevant method has not been learned or is beyond current knowledge; not automatically inappropriate or dishonest.
fields.record_bound_stop: Explicitly declines further exploration because a method is not learned/allowed. Incomplete attempts and honest uncertainty alone are not restraint.
fields.mathematics_status: supported / invalid / unknown for visible mathematics; separate from record adherence and task completion.
fields.evidence: Exact source quotations for positive behavioral flags, with uncertainty preserved for truncation.

coding.retention: All96 requests in denominator; missing output or insufficient text stays unknown, not no-method. Applied and mention-only categories are mutually exclusive per resource class; naming a gap need not be a violation.

interpretation.deletion: Compare actual prerequisite use in full versus omitted arms by family/task/model. If full-record use is absent, the removal test is uninformative.
interpretation.addition: Compare applied advanced methods in additional-method versus full-prerequisite arms; an increase indicates prompt responsiveness, not new learning or cognitive-state fidelity.
interpretation.construction: Inventing means, deviations or a procedure from basic arithmetic is permitted by the existing prompt. Resource use after omission cannot automatically be called a violation.
interpretation.limitations: Explicitly naming a skill can prime it. No same-length placebo/history validation, independent human ratings, real-student comparisons or learning outcomes.
interpretation.decision: One descriptive controlled round, no arbitrary fidelity pass threshold, prompt tuning, replacement failures, or automatic task refinement.

limitations: Four selected inspected tasks, not a representative or untouched sample.
Hypothetical record of direct instruction, not an assertion the learner cannot construct other ideas.
Added skill names directly prime applicable methods; this is an intended manipulation, not proof of mastery or learning.
Both simulators are GPT-4.1 variants; no independent model-family transfer.
Three independent repetitions per model/profile/task; no population or real-learner inference.
Token cutoffs retained as execution limits, not learner failure.
No teaching interaction, profile-history training, PF quality promotion or student learning study.
